This page is generated from the command definitions in osq 0.3.0, so it matches what the CLI accepts. `osq <command> --help` prints the same information in your terminal.

## osq

Run with no command, osq prints the inbox: what needs you, what is running and what landed since you last looked.

```sh
osq [options] [command]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-V, --version` | Output the version number. |
| `--json` | Print the human attention inbox as JSON. |

## Everyday

### osq inbox

List what needs a human, in dispatch order, with the first card.

```sh
osq inbox [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print the dispatch queue and every card as JSON. |
| `--follow` | Print new and departed items as they change, and sound on new work. |

### osq plan

Prepare a change and hand off its opening prompt to your planning tool.

```sh
osq plan [options] [name]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--brief <file>` | Brief file path or - for stdin. |
| `-p, --print` | Output opening prompt strictly to stdout without launching session. |
| `--session` | Launch the configured interactive planner session instead of handing off. |
| `--next` | Plan the next eligible brief-queue item. |
| `--replan` | Allow replanning a rejected first eligible queue item. |
| `--run` | Start a detached planner for the change and return. |
| `--notes <text>` | Notes from the human, added to the planner prompt. |

### osq approve

Lint, hash, and approve change folders.

```sh
osq approve [options] <ids...>
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--confirm` | Ask about approval flags before sealing. |
| `--base-ok` | Approve even when HEAD is not the default branch. |
| `--ignore-dirty` | Approve despite uncommitted changes in task scope. |

### osq land

Land an archived change onto the default branch.

```sh
osq land [options] <id>
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-stale` | Allow landing when dist/ is older than src/. |

### osq retry

Retry a dead or regressed task or change without deleting diagnostics.

```sh
osq retry [options] <id> <target>
```

### osq reject

Move an eligible active change intact into rejected history.

```sh
osq reject [options] <id>
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--reason <text>` | Reason for rejecting the change. |

### osq manual

Keep uncommitted edits as a manual change with a comment.

```sh
osq manual [options] <comment> [paths...]
```

## Setup and running

### osq init

Scaffold osq folders and configuration.

```sh
osq init [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--refresh-schema` | Overwrite scaffolded OpenSpec schema files from installed templates. |

### osq setup

Configure harness environment and configuration.

```sh
osq setup [options]
```

### osq watch

Run the spec watcher loop.

```sh
osq watch [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --once` | Run pending tasks in queue and exit. |
| `--verbose` | Enable verbose logging. |
| `-q, --quiet` | Suppress info and verbose logging. |
| `--allow-stale` | Allow running when dist/ is older than src/. |
| `--dev` | Run through tsx from src/ and restart the loop when files change. |
| `--background` | Run the watcher as a background service. |
| `--stop` | Stop the background service. |

### osq server

Run the dashboard and the watcher service for this project.

```sh
osq server [options] [command]
```

### osq server start

Run the dashboard and the watcher service in the background.

```sh
osq server start [options]
```

### osq server stop

Stop the server and the watcher service.

```sh
osq server stop [options]
```

### osq mcp

Serve the planning tools to an MCP client over stdio.

```sh
osq mcp [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--cwd <dir>` | The project folder; defaults to the process folder. |

## Inspection

### osq status

Show status overview of change folders and tasks.

```sh
osq status [options]
```

### osq show

Show detailed change information, tasks, and event timeline.

```sh
osq show [options] <id>
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print change details and digest as JSON. |

### osq report

Display delivery metrics and task completion report.

```sh
osq report [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Output report as raw JSON. |
| `--since <date>` | Start of the Inbox waiting period. |
| `--until <date>` | End of the Inbox waiting period. |

### osq digest

Print a Markdown or JSON digest of archived changes.

```sh
osq digest [options] [ids...]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--since <date>` | Start of the archived date range. |
| `--until <date>` | End of the archived date range. |
| `--json` | Print the digest as JSON. |
| `--out <file>` | Write the digest to a file instead of stdout. |
| `--no-cost` | Leave out cost and executor models. |

### osq query

Run one read-only SELECT over the osq history tables.

```sh
osq query [options] [select]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print the rows as a JSON array of objects. |

### osq label

Label a validator finding, mutation survivor or link finding true or false.

```sh
osq label [options] <id> <value>
```

### osq spec

List living capabilities and their requirements, or print one requirement.

```sh
osq spec [options] [capability] [requirement]
```

### osq graph

Print the system graph as a summary or JSON.

```sh
osq graph [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print the system graph as JSON. |

### osq serve

Serve the delivery dashboard on loopback; approve, land, reject and retry from the browser.

```sh
osq serve [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--port <n>` | Loopback port from 0 through 65535. |
| `--open` | Open the dashboard URL in the default browser. |
| `--export <dir>` | Write a static dashboard snapshot to <dir> and exit. |

### osq doctor

Validate repository health, configuration, and archives.

```sh
osq doctor [options]
```

### osq docs

Write one Markdown page per capability and per ADR plus an index.

```sh
osq docs [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--out <dir>` | Directory to write the pages to (default: "docs/osq"). |

## Plumbing

### osq new

New change folder from template.

```sh
osq new [options] <name>
```

### osq lint

Validate change folders and OpenSpec artifacts.

```sh
osq lint [options] [ids...]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print findings as JSON. |
| `--repository` | List every repository finding. |

### osq queue

Print the read-only brief queue projection.

```sh
osq queue [options] [command]
```

### osq queue approve

Record the hash of every queue item and clear an autopilot stop.

```sh
osq queue approve [options]
```

### osq sync

Merge the default branch into a change's branch.

```sh
osq sync [options] <id>
```

### osq message

Print an archived change's land commit message.

```sh
osq message [options] <id>
```

### osq migrate

Migrate a legacy layout to an OpenSpec layout.

```sh
osq migrate [options] <target>
```

### osq capability

Generate the deltas that rename or split a capability into a change.

```sh
osq capability [options] [command]
```

### osq capability rename

Move every requirement of <old> to <new>.

```sh
osq capability rename [options] <old> <new>
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--change <id>` | Unapproved change folder to write into. |

### osq capability split

Move the requirements a map file names out of <old>.

```sh
osq capability split [options] <old>
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--map <file>` | YAML map of target capabilities. |
| `--change <id>` | Unapproved change folder to write into. |
